pricing_order_agent (:8013)
调用 bundle_math_tools.py 受控凑单器

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
1. 按优惠前原价小计 (cents)
匹配 1 张最优品类券 + 1 档跨店满减
(按 shop_id 汇总参与满减金额)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
2. 距离下一档满减门槛差额
0 < gap_cents <= 4000分(40元)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 直接输出当前必买组合报价 quote_id

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
3. 从预设 <=15 件高好评日常凑单池中
穷举挑选 1~2 件商品组合 (最多 C(15,1)+C(15,2)=120 种)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
4. 检查加购后实付:
payable_with_addon < payable_without_addon?
